name: genizahsearch
description: Search the Cairo Genizah manuscripts of Dicta Genizah Search: phrases, shelfmarks, passage parallels, manuscript pages with citations, and catalogue records.

interface.longDescription: Research the Cairo Genizah with Dicta Genizah Search. Find manuscripts containing a Hebrew or Judeo-Arabic word or phrase (exact, with common spelling variants, or near spellings), look up a shelfmark such as T-S 12.123 or ENA 1628.38, find parallels to a passage across the corpus, read a manuscript page with its transcription and a citation that credits whoever made the text, and read catalogue records and bibliography. Answers link to each page on genizahsearch.com. Free; no account needed.
